instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and back straight.
3. Drive through your heels and jump straight up, extending your legs fully.
4. Land softly on the balls of your feet and bend your knees to absorb the impact.
5. Lower straight into the next squat. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your knees tracking over your toes on the descent and landing.
2. Land soft and quiet to reduce joint impact.
3. Brace your core to control the dumbbells through the jump.
4. Use a moderate weight so you can land under control.

instructions:
1. Place your right knee and right hand on a bench, with your left foot flat on the floor.
2. Lean forward until your torso is parallel to the floor and keep your back flat.
3. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with your upper arm against your side and your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
4. Straighten your elbow to extend the dumbbell back until your arm is fully extended.
5. Slowly bend your elbow to return to the start, keeping your upper arm still. Switch sides. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arm pinned to your side to isolate the triceps.
2. Squeeze the triceps hard at full extension.
3. Move slowly and avoid swinging the dumbbell.
4. Keep your back flat and core braced to stop your torso twisting.

instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor with your knees shoulder-width apart and your torso upright.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing your body and elbows bent.
3. Press the dumbbells overhead while rotating your palms to face forward until your arms are fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height while rotating your palms back toward your body.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your spine neutral and core braced to stop your back arching.
2. Move smoothly and let the rotation flow with the press.
3. Squeeze your shoulders at the top of each rep.
4. Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

instructions:
1. Kneel on both knees with a dumbbell in each hand held at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
2. Step one foot forward and plant it flat to form a 90-degree angle at the knee.
3. Drive through the front foot to stand up, bringing the other foot in to stand tall.
4. Step one foot back and lower that knee to the floor, then the other, returning to kneeling.
5. Alternate the leading leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee aligned over your ankle.
2. Drive through the heel of the front foot to stand.
3. Brace your core to keep your torso upright through the transition.
4. Use a controlled tempo on the way down to the floor.

instructions:
1. Kneel with both knees on the floor and your torso upright from knees to shoulders.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
3. Push your hips back and sit down toward your heels, keeping your torso upright.
4. Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to upright.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your glutes hard as you drive your hips forward.
2. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
3. Brace your core throughout the movement.
4. Control the descent to protect your knees.
